rationale: The primary bearish thesis remains intact as MRNA trades near the bottom of its daily range (5.1%), well below both session VWAP ($207.83) and the declining 5-minute 9-EMA ($188.91). After printing a new session low at $182.70 on elevated volume (140.6k shares), the subsequent three-minute bounce to $185.69 has occurred on steadily declining volume, indicating a low-conviction relief bounce rather than a structural reversal. With broader market weakness accelerating (SPY -1.32%, VIXY +5.63%) and price still comfortably below the $192.00 invalidation level, holding for another leg down is warranted.
